body:
Great idea, def support.

One thing i've noted on a couple of the feature requests is this can take three forms:

1. Integrate / port over well known / established projects using the EVM


1. Fnd teams who are currently ETH native and working with them to advance their functionality to Substrate. 


1. Partner with native Substrate / Web3 foundation grants that are prioritising native Substrate solutions that will work for a solo chain like EDG


In the end the former is quick fix, but we are a small fish in a big pond, the latter, is where we build genuine novelty, the middle is the bridge.
